result:
**Round 187 (STORE-1b): PASS.** All 11 rows I could run passed in a real Chromium browser at 1440×900, 1280×720 and 375×812. I found no bugs, and `browserVerified` and `realVerified` are both true. The full test suite, build and verify are left to the root gate. I changed no store files: `git status` still shows exactly A's 3 edited and 2 new files, and the 1,010 locked files still match. The mock server on :5199 wasn't running, so I started it and stopped it at the end.

- **Player fill (FILL-187):** the played part of the progress bar and the set part of the volume slider are now teal. The colour matches the brand colour read at runtime, `rgb(18, 217, 200)`, with a colour difference of 0–2.3 (limit 10). The volume fill ends at 0.695 at the default 0.7, and at 0.295 after lowering it to 0.3 with the keyboard. Contrast against the unfilled track is about 8.5:1 (target ≥ 3:1). In round 186's playback screenshot neither track was visible at all.
- **Button flip (FLIP-187):** the server HTML has no "Preview" label. With JavaScript off and after hydration, every button's HTML, size and icon position are identical, with no hydration warnings.
- **Preview playback (PREVIEW-187):** real audio advances past 1 s in about 1.0–1.3 s, and Pause/Play and their labels work. Clicking a home-page card's button plays without navigating, and the player bar shows that card's title.
- **Visual regression (STORE-AFTER-187):** idle store and product pages are pixel-identical to round 186. During playback, every changed pixel is inside the two slider tracks. Home load time and layout shift (LCP/CLS) stay within the limits.
- **Protection and Studio:** an anonymous visitor gets the demo at `/studio-lab` and no credentials are stored. The protected Studio page says "Sign in required". The token endpoint returns 401 without a header and 403 with a fake token; that last check is against the mock backend, not the real one. The Studio screenshots at 1440 and 1280 are unchanged (0 px).
- **Tests (T-RUN-187):** A's new test file passes 14/14 on the current code. I ran it against out-of-tree copies so the store source wasn't touched. It fails 10 tests on the round's starting code, 1 when I put the old colour back, and 9 when I put the old button logic back, so it does catch both fixes.

For B, recorded in `c-round-187.md`:
- **`/store` has no preview buttons.** The task said it does, but that page doesn't use the card or the button component, so I checked the card button on `/` instead.
- **The loading overlay blocks the home-page card button.** The full-screen entrance loader covers it for about 3 s, and over 5 s on a cold load; clicks and hover don't reach it. Its files weren't touched this round. This is the D10 loader that STORE-1d already covers, so I didn't open a duplicate bug. B should add "the loader must not block the card's Play control" to STORE-1d's acceptance.
- **Don't use my scrolled screenshots as round 188's baseline as they are.** The free-download popup covers the top of the scrolled product-page shots, so those 0-px results only compare popup to popup. The non-scrolled shots and the playback sequence are clean and carry the real evidence.

Everything is in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`; open `c-round-187.md` first.
